customer: Seriously, I'm trying to trade in my hatchback for something bigger and now I'm told my ex has to be involved? We've been divorced for ages and their name is still on the title. Is there any way around this?
agent: I understand how frustrating that is. Per our article "My ex is still on the title," an ex-spouse who's still listed on the title has to sign, the same as any co-owner. The exception is if your divorce decree awards the car to you: just bring a certified copy of the decree and your ex's signature isn't needed. If your name changed in the divorce, take a look at "The name on the title doesn't match my ID" as well.
